name: niko-studio
description: Niko-Studio Desktop — AI Writing Assistant. A desktop-native creative writing platform with deep AI integration, craft analysis, story bible management, co-writing engine, reader simulation, and narrative visualization.

features.name: AI Chat & Agent Writing
features.description: Multi-level workflow chat (L1-L5) with agent routing, scene writing, revision, and context retrieval. Supports model comparison and quality goals tuning.

features.name: Story Bible & QC
features.description: Automatic extraction and manual management of characters, world-rules, plot-threads, and timeline-events. Completeness scoring and canon promotion to wiki.

features.name: Co-Writing Engine
features.description: AI co-writing with three modes: Auto (seamless continuation), Guided (3 divergent options), and Directed (explicit instruction following). Context scraper + prompt assembler + model router pipeline.

features.name: Reader Simulation
features.description: Dual-engine reader simulation with persona engine + editorial analysis engine. 4-dimension analysis, consensus engine, overlay bridge, and report generation.

features.name: Writing Craft Analysis
features.description: 9-dimension writing analysis: structure, character, suspense, emotion, dialogue, webnovel, show/tell, hook, cliffhanger. Score-based feedback with evidence and suggestions.

features.name: Emotional Arc & Tension Curve
features.description: Cross-chapter emotional arc visualization, tension desert detection, and curve matching against classic templates.

features.name: Narrative Visualization
features.description: Timeline view with zoom/filter, reader state + tension curve view, character graph view with interaction. Cytoscape-based graph rendering.

features.name: Voice Fingerprint & Consistency
features.description: 5-dimension voice fingerprint extraction (sentence length, catchphrases, formality, emotional expression, rhetorical habits) with consistency tracking across chapters.

features.name: Show vs Tell Detection
features.description: Paragraph-level show/tell heatmap with sensory coverage analysis and inline editor decorations.

features.name: Intelligent Revision
features.description: Multi-pass revision protocol with target score, iteration tracking, and style profile extraction/application.

features.name: Session Intelligence & Style Personalization
features.description: Session-level analytics, style personalization service, and context-aware suggestions.

features.name: Knowledge Graph & Memory
features.description: Workspace-scoped knowledge graph with entity relationships, memory search/add/upload, and embedding-based retrieval.

features.name: Project Wiki / Canon
features.description: Wiki canon pages with promotion from story bible, chat, or research. Markdown-based with curated/draft status.

features.name: Plugin System
features.description: Dynamic plugin registration and execution with manifest-based rules. Keyword-scoring plugin architecture.

features.name: Export System
features.description: Multi-format export: Markdown, HTML, PDF, DOCX. Project-level or current-chapter scope. Export history tracking.

features.name: Cloud Sync
features.description: Push/pull/full sync with remote URL and auth token. Conflict detection and sync status monitoring.

features.name: Evaluation & Critic
features.description: Content evaluation with module scores (lock, style, logic), consistency checking (character, timeline, worldview), and publish recommendation.

features.name: Skills System
features.description: Skill registry with list/load/match/chain/create/save/delete operations. Category-based skill organization.

features.name: Workflow Engine
features.description: Task decomposition, plan execution, recommendations, and checkpoint management with rollback support.

features.name: Intelligent Learning Pipelines
features.description: Import learning, self-evolving writing, and reading learning pipelines with shared infrastructure.

features.name: Tiptap Rich Text Editor
features.description: Custom editor with slash commands, callouts, math blocks, tables, show/tell decorations, voice consistency decorations, and bubble toolbar.

features.name: Foreshadowing Tracker
features.description: Track and visualize foreshadowing elements across chapters with payoff monitoring.

features.name: Character Relationship Panel
features.description: Interactive character relationship visualization and management.

features.name: Onboarding & Welcome Wizard
features.description: First-run onboarding with localStorage gating and guided setup.

features.name: i18n Internationalization
features.description: Multi-language support with i18next, module-split translations, and index aggregator pattern.

features.name: Auto-Updater
features.description: Tauri-based auto-updater with signed releases and update notifications.

features.name: Obsidian Integration
features.description: Optional vault integration with .niko-studio/ metadata directory parallel to .obsidian/. Non-intrusive design.

architecture.pattern: Desktop-native hybrid (Tauri + React frontend + Node.js sidecar gateway)
layers: UI Layer: React components + Zustand stores
API Bridge: Desktop API wrappers (callApi pattern) → MCP endpoints
Gateway Layer: Node.js sidecar with MCP endpoint routing
Backend Services: Rust Tauri shell + plugin system
keyPrinciples: MCP endpoint exposure for all new capabilities
Three-layer bridge: MCP Endpoint → Desktop API → React Components
DI registration with bindSingleton + ServiceTypes Symbol
Backward compatibility: no breaking interface changes within major versions

aiCapabilities: Multi-level workflow chat with agent routing (L1-L5)
AI scene writing and revision with quality goals
Reader simulation with persona + editorial dual engines
Emotional arc and tension curve analysis
Voice fingerprint extraction and consistency tracking
Show vs tell detection with sensory coverage
Multi-pass intelligent revision with style profiles
Knowledge retrieval with hybrid search modes
LLM fallback with detection evasion guard
uiFramework: React 18 + Tailwind CSS + Tiptap editor + Cytoscape graphs + Zustand state management

extensibility.pluginSystem: Manifest-based dynamic plugin registration with keyword-scoring rules
extensibility.skillSystem: Skill registry with matching, chaining, and custom creation
extensibility.mcpEndpoints: All capabilities exposed via MCP endpoints for external integration

targetUsers: Creative writers, novelists, web novel authors, and storytellers seeking AI-assisted writing, analysis, and world-building tools
